opening.evidence: events/game_start.txt:448 fires hidden shroud.8000 (events/origin_events_shadows_shroud.txt:3532-3588: spawns the shrouded world, schedules 8010 after 30 days). 8480/8481: common/resolutions/05_resolutions_shroud.txt:189/197. 8600: end_aura on_start via check_end_aura_win_condition for origin_endbringers; 8700 on_fleet_destroyed_perp common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1693 -> 8710.

uncertain: Which delve actually triggers on_shroud_delve (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5806) was not traced to the delve decision itself.
The generic End of the Cycle situation and the Reckoning chains are cut from this tree; they belong to the Shroud stories (C8c).

suppress.evidence: Shared with the generic End of the Cycle covenant (shroud.4135 and the Shroud patron story): common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:1-12 accept_end_of_the_cycle starts end_of_the_cycle_endbringers for the origin and the generic end_of_the_cycle for everyone else; common/situations/13_shroud_situations.txt:559-728 vs :1018-1196.
try_start_chain_aura_suppressors in accept_end_of_the_cycle is a generic side effect shared by every covenant (common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:1-40).
Reckoning chains are shared with the generic covenant situation (common/situations/13_shroud_situations.txt:578 / :1037).

shroud.4954/4955 monthly dread events are generic to both covenant situations (common/situations/13_shroud_situations.txt:1192-1193 and :723-724).
utopia.2602 comes from the generic mind_over_matter_immediate effect (common/scripted_effects/shroud_shadows_scripted_effects.txt:56-63), shared with the other psionic ascension variants.

bridges.evidence: common/traditions/01_psionics_shroud.txt:33 tr_psionics_shroud_adopt on_enabled fires 8310 for origin_endbringers (events/origin_events_shadows_shroud.txt:3982-4080); the project only enables the tradition option.

notes.zh: 与终末之环缔结盟约；对本起源开始专属局势“终末之环（终焉者）”，其他帝国则开始通用的“终末之环”局势（在“虚境”故事中）。
notes.en: Covenant with the End of the Cycle: starts the origin-specific end_of_the_cycle_endbringers situation; other empires start the generic situation, which belongs to the Shroud stories.

notes.zh: 结局依赖“虚境”调查：遗址五个阶段（8100–8120）→ 项目“灵能理论” → 8200 → 采用灵能传统项目。
notes.en: Shrouded World site stages 8100-8120 -> project Psionic Theory -> 8200 -> adopt the Psionics tradition project.
